Definition: from G1 (as negative particle) and G1108; ignorance (properly, the state):--ignorance, not the knowledge.
BiblicalUsage: Agnosia is ignorance — not knowing God — and it appears twice, both times as a rebuke. Paul tells the Corinthians to awake to righteousness and sin not, 'for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame'; and Peter says it is the will of God that by well-doing you put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
TheologicalSignificance: Some have not the knowledge of God, Paul says, and this word names their ignorance — the shame is theirs, and the verse speaks it plainly.
